summary: Adversarial search for an architecture strictly superior to the five-pillar legal superweapon

result.synthesis:
1) BOTTOM LINE

CEILING MOVES — genuine strictly-superior element(s) found, but ENTIRELY WITHIN the five-pillar frame. No sixth pillar survived: all six lenses self-classified or were judged UPGRADE_TO_EXISTING_PILLAR, and every attempt to name an orthogonal new trust primitive collapsed into a recomposition of Pillars 1–5. The five-pillar ARCHITECTURE (the set of trust axes and the count) is confirmed as the ceiling. But four of the six attacks closed a REAL hole that the pillars-as-written did not contain, each strictly superior on its axis and worse on none. The ceiling did not gain a floor above it; it got sharper in four places. Honest reading: the framework is unbeaten; three specific pillars were genuinely under-specified and are now stronger.

2) GENUINE ADDITIONS (survived non-compensatory review)

- PRECLUSION CONTROL → UPGRADE to Pillar 4. Mechanism: lift Adversarial Completeness from single-node ∀∃ dominance ("we can win every line") to a forward controllable-predecessor/safety-game fixpoint over Pillar-2 irreversibility doctrines (δεδικασμένο, estoppel, waiver, prescription, KPolD default), emitting a preclusion certificate that a whole class of opponent moves is provably inadmissible and STAYS empty under all reachable play — plus a mandatory second proof that the same irreversibility does not adversely self-bind us. Deleting a branch strictly dominates winning it. Genuinely additive: node-enumeration cannot express a reachability invariant over a sequential game.

- INTERPRETIVE COMPLETENESS / QUALIFICATION LATTICE → UPGRADE to Pillar 4 (+ new boundary object in Pillar 2, accrual in Pillar 5). Mechanism: redefine Pillar 4's search domain from {moves | fixed reading, fixed characterization} to the pruned product {admissible construals of each open predicate} × {admissible fact-characterizations} × {moves}, each construal emitted by an untrusted generator, admitted only if it cites a real re-fetchable authority and passes dialectical admissibility, readings dominated by higher-priority canons pruned. Closes the elite adversary's actual highest-value move — shifting the Qualifikation, not playing within it. This is the single most important addition (see §5).

- REALIZED-OUTCOME LOOP → UPGRADE to Pillar 5 (+ Pillar 3 discipline + the autodidactic loop). Mechanism: pre-register, in append-only tamper-evident memory BEFORE outcome, each open-textured argument-line with a MECHANICALLY-APPLICABLE reference-class predicate and a predicted disposition; the later provenance-anchored judgment closes the prediction; confidence becomes replayable arithmetic (prevail-rate, Brier, n) over the pre-registered class — proof-carrying-over-data, never a model self-report; the calibration reward extends the existing verified-learning loop into the one region (good faith, proportionality) it explicitly excluded. Conditional on the MANDATORY anti-gaming guardrail (predicate pre-registered and mechanically applied, thin class → honest «δεν ξέρω»), without which the honest-ignorance axis degrades and the "worse-on-none" claim fails.

- OUTCOME SOVEREIGNTY / TRIBUNAL-ADOPTION COMPILER → UPGRADE to Pillar 3 (drafting/output faculty). Mechanism: a deterministic downstream transform that renders an already-certified conclusion into the Greek tribunal's own issuing schema (confirmed facts → law by ELI citation → node-by-node subsumption → operative part), each node linked to re-fetchable provenance, minimizing the judge's verify-and-sign cost per node. Names a real, previously-unstated target — a proof the court never runs is causally inert on the court. Two hard constraints keep it non-degrading: it consumes only core-certified content (no LLM between certification and emission), and open-texture nodes are STRUCTURALLY flagged in the output type, not stylistically softened.

3) HONESTLY REJECTED (searched, not declared)

- CROSS-FOUNDATIONAL N-KERNEL UNANIMITY (assurance) — REJECTED as strictly superior; COMPENSATORY. The Gödel-II reasoning is sound but misaimed: legal deadline/threshold/element computations are finitary and decidable, living in weak arithmetic far below the choice/large-cardinal strength where ZFC/CIC/HOL could diverge — it buys defense against a risk the domain never incurs. Worse-on-none is FALSE: mandatory unanimity halts on any single-kernel bug or encoding mismatch (worse liveness → more spurious «δεν ξέρω», directly contradicting its own effectiveness claim), enlarges the TCB with a faithfulness-critical cross-foundation transport (violates Pillar 3 minimality), and the foundations are not consistency-independent (HOL interprets into ZFC). Adopted only as a near-zero-cost sharpening: Pillar 3's "independently-reproducible" should prefer a foundationally-distinct kernel where naturally expressible, and a second-foundation cross-check as a NON-blocking flag for a top tier of highest-stakes conclusions only.

- ADVERSARY-FED ANTIFRAGILE RATCHET (moat) — REJECTED as strictly superior; reducible + rides on out-of-scope volume. Every architectural component already exists: formalizing public records is Pillar 2, capturing judge/opponent behavior is Pillar 5 verbatim, enumeration is Pillar 4, the one-way information flow is a CONSEQUENCE of Pillars 1–3 (not a new mechanism), provenance sourcing is the person-research faculty. The headline "adversary-powered antifragile growth" leans on ingesting MORE public records — CONTENT VOLUME, explicitly conceded and out of scope. Because it preserves completeness (priors weight, never prune) and the core still decides, prior-weighting changes only search ORDER/latency, not the decided output. Adopted only as: (a) an actor-keyed index/view over Pillar-5 memory, and (b) a MANDATORY mutation-adversary test proving the enumeration set and decided output are bit-for-bit invariant under any prior perturbation — itself an instance of existing Pillar-4 completeness discipline.

- The recurring failure signature across all six: each strongest idea reused Pillar 4 as a subroutine, Pillar 2 as its predicates, Pillar 3 as its checker, and left Pillar 1's boundary untouched — non-orthogonality plus explicit subroutine-reuse is the decisive tell of an upgrade, not a new axis. That is the proof the search was real: the pillars are closed under these attacks.

4) THE REFINED ARCHITECTURE (still FIVE pillars, three sharpened)

1. TRUST INVERSION — unchanged. Untrusted intelligence proposes; a tiny, total, decidable, deterministic core decides. (Every upgrade below verified as respecting this — no LLM enters the trusted path in any of them.)

2. LAW-AS-CODE (with an honest boundary) — computational law formalized; open-textured law as structured defeasible argument. NOW ALSO carries a NEW first-class honest-ignorance object: the construal generator's DECLARED COVERAGE BOUNDARY, enforced structurally (the core is architecturally incapable of emitting an unqualified "complete"; every completeness verdict is stamped "relative to declared coverage C"; a missing coverage certificate is a hard refusal).

3. ANSWER-AS-PROOF — machine-checkable proof, minimal itself-verified independently-reproducible checker. SHARPENED: independent reproduction prefers a foundationally-distinct kernel where naturally expressible (same-logic re-runs reproduce foundational assumptions); a second-foundation cross-check is a non-blocking flag for top-tier conclusions only. EXTENDED: an adoption-cost output contract renders certified conclusions into the tribunal's own issuing schema for a human verifier (Outcome Sovereignty), open-texture structurally flagged in the output type.

4. ADVERSARIAL COMPLETENESS — SHARPENED on two fronts. (a) Domain lifted to the pruned product {interpretations × characterizations × moves} — Qualifikation and fact-characterization become searched objects, not fixed inputs (Interpretive Completeness). (b) Reactive node-dominance extended to proactive sequential move-space annihilation: a forward safety-game fixpoint over Pillar-2 preclusion doctrines, emitting preclusion certificates with a mandatory non-self-binding proof (Preclusion Control). Both preserve "weight/search, never prune" and revert to defeasible argument at declared open-textured edges.

5. PERFECT, VERIFIED, REPRODUCIBLE MEMORY — EXTENDED from passive record into a falsifiable experiment log: pre-registered predictions + reference-class predicates, outcome closure, proof-carrying-over-data confidence, and a calibration reward feeding the autodidactic loop in the open-textured region (Realized-Outcome Loop) — gated by mandatory anti-gerrymandering guardrails. Also holds actor-keyed indices and quarantined canon-priority priors as non-formal, replayable assumptions.

Plus the whole-office pipeline and provenance-anchored person-research, unchanged.

5) THE ONE HARDEST FRONTIER

The construal generator's coverage boundary in Interpretive Completeness (Pillar 4 lifted to the Qualifikation lattice). This is the real research crux because it is where the system's central promise — "misses nothing / invents nothing," the edge that beats elite humans — actually lives or dies. Against a sophisticated adversary the dominant move is to shift the reading or the characterization, so completeness over a fixed compilation is FALSE completeness precisely against the target adversary. But the space of "every interpretation a court could be persuaded to accept" is not decidable; the enumeration rests on an untrusted, possibly under-inclusive generator. So the guarantee is necessarily "complete relative to the generator's DECLARED coverage" — the same species as Pillar 2's "where formalization stops," and the honesty of the whole weapon reduces to whether that coverage boundary can be made structurally un-fakeable and empirically tightened over time. Every other upgrade is comparatively closed-form (a fixpoint, a schema transform, an arithmetic-over-data reward). This one is where formalization genuinely meets its limit, and where honest ignorance must be engineered into the type system rather than promised by discipline.
